craft_notes: Sthāyin: gatekeeper-praise (breath-bodied first worship). Rows: row 3 (saluted→praise). Close: praise (vande refrain-verb; first of many). Rejected: 'first' for foremost — killed: foremost kept (agrya as rank, not order); 'Hosts salute him' active flip — killed: saluted kept (the verse's passive piles the hosts first).

lines: Saluted by demon-and-god hosts, on wished-for boons intent —

reads_against.argmap: Who stands at the gate? → Gaṇapati as prāṇa-gatekeeper: worshipped first, breath-bodied, boon-bestowing (Dyczkowski: master of the body's pīṭhas).
c1_essence: Breath-bodied Gaṇapati first-worshipped: saluted by all beings, bestowing wished boons.
reads_against.c1_rasa: adbhuta with bhakti (wonder held in devotion)
